label: Whatever COMPREHEND_1s a being COMPREHEND_2s it
paraphrase: OPEN sense bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For every x and y: if x stands in the primitive comprehension relation to y (COMPREHEND_1, Comprehension.Comprehends, definition 4afe4ab4: glossed as knowing y as perfectly as y is knowable), then x knows y at some degree that reaches y's knowability (COMPREHEND_2, definition 1218cc1e). It carries the comparison between knowing and knowability for COMPREHEND_1 pairs on the one scale of definition 5b196f1c, and requires every COMPREHEND_1 to show up as some KnowsAt degree. Commensurability is not carried by this bridge alone: 'Everything is knowable at least to the degree it is in act' (act <= knowability), 'Nothing knows anything at a degree above its own degree of act' (knowing <= the knower's act) and 'Whatever is INFINITE_1 has a maximal degree of act' (through IsTop, every degree at most the INFINITE_1's act) impose it as well; it is the main open warrant gap of the account. Lead, not a substantive objection: q.13 a.5 (attributed, unpinned) says names are said of God and creatures by analogy, not univocally, which bears against a univocal scale; the Preorder accommodates incomparability except where these premises force a comparison. The converse is not assumed (Control part 7). Needed: without it, the COMPREHEND_2 bridge holds and the COMPREHEND_1 bridge fails (Control part 6).
